meta.name: Diamonds: Three-Hand Vault
meta.blurb: Three players, three hands of ten tricks: every suit moves crystals into your showroom (1 point) or vault (2 points), or steals them.

setup.label: the starting table
setup.text: The deck holds {deck_size} cards. Every showroom, vault and score starts at 0.

rules:
Three players sit in fixed order A (seat 1), B (seat 2), C (seat 3). 'Left' is the next seat: A's left is B, B's left is C, C's left is A. The deck has {deck_size} cards: Diamonds (D), Hearts (H), Spades (S) and Clubs (C), each ranked {lowest_rank} to {highest_rank}, written like D7 or C1. Crystals come from an unlimited supply. Each player has a showroom and a vault, both starting empty; their counts are public.

The game is {hands} hands of {tricks_per_hand} tricks, one trick per round, {total_rounds} rounds in all. The dealer is C for hand 1, A for hand 2 and B for hand 3; the player on the dealer's left leads the first trick of the hand.

DEAL AND PASS (first round of each hand): all {deck_size} cards are shuffled, {cards_dealt_per_player} are dealt face down to each player and the other {cards_set_aside} are set aside face down, unseen during the hand. All players at the same moment secretly choose exactly {cards_passed} different cards from their hand and give them to the player on their left; the passed cards are not announced. Every player's won-card counts and trick count reset to 0.

PLAYING A TRICK: the leader plays any card face up and names one opponent as their Clubs target. Then the next player to the left plays a card and names a Clubs target, then the third player. The suit of the first card is the led suit. A player who holds a card of the led suit must play one; a player who holds none may play any card. OFF-SUIT ACTION: when a player plays a card not of the led suit, they immediately take that card's suit action, before the next player plays. The highest card of the led suit wins the trick. The winner adds the 3 cards to their won counts by suit and 1 to their trick count, then takes the led suit's action, then leads the next trick. Everything played and every action is announced.

SUIT ACTIONS: Diamonds: move 1 crystal from the supply to your vault. Hearts: move 1 crystal from the supply to your showroom. Spades: move 1 crystal from your showroom to your vault; if your showroom is empty, nothing happens. Clubs (from a trick or an off-suit play): move 1 crystal from your named Clubs target's showroom to your own showroom; if that showroom is empty, nothing happens.

END OF HAND (after the 10th trick): for each suit in turn (Diamonds, Hearts, Spades, Clubs), the player with strictly the most won cards of that suit takes that suit's action once; if the top count is tied, no one takes it. An end-of-hand Clubs action robs the opponent with the larger showroom; if those opponents are tied, it robs the one on the receiver's left; if that showroom is empty, nothing moves. Each player who won 0 tricks in the hand takes two Diamonds actions (vault +{zero_trick_diamond_actions}). The {cards_set_aside} set-aside cards are then revealed and all cards are gathered for the next deal.

SCORING: each vault crystal is worth {vault_crystal_points} points and each showroom crystal {showroom_crystal_points} point. After round {total_rounds} and the third end-of-hand step the game ends. The highest score wins; on a score tie, the tied player with more vault crystals wins; players still tied share the win (a draw).
